component.name: vinoPilot
component.summary: The vinoPilot family of AI apps for Intel NPUs

description.p: vinoPilot is a suite of apps for Linux laptops with an Intel NPU, bringing Copilot+ PC features to Linux: live captions, face unlock, video call effects, AI text tools, text-to-speech, and local search. Everything runs locally on the NPU with OpenVINO, requiring no account or cloud service while keeping power usage low.
This app manages the suite from a single window, letting you install, update, and uninstall each component.

ul.li: vinoWhisper: live captions and voice typing
vinoAuthFace: face authentication for login and sudo
vinoOpenEffects: webcam background blur and studio lighting for video calls
vinoPop: AI actions on selected text
vinoSpeak: natural-sounding local text-to-speech
vinoSearch: semantic local file search
vinoWatch: live Intel NPU activity monitor
ovfetch: downloads the OpenVINO runtime required for Intel NPUs

description.p: Each app installs using its own checksum-verified GitHub release installer, or from source, PyPI, or crates.io. vinoPilot also detects previously installed apps, shows how each one was installed, and updates it from the matching source. No network requests are made until you click Check for updates.

Managed apps install directly onto your system rather than inside a sandbox. Most install into your home directory using your local tools, while vinoAuthFace installs system-wide and prompts for your password.
